description: This file declares functions and structures for managing nl80211 wireless interface events, configurations, and information retrieval within an access point context, specifically for nl80211-based Wi-Fi management.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_setEvtListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for nl80211 events on an AP interface, registering callback handlers.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_delEvtListener
methods.description: Deletes the event listener for an AP interface.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_getInterfaceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific AP or MLD interface, including physical and logical details.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_delVapInterface
methods.description: Deletes an AP virtual interface, possibly reverting it to station mode if it matches the main interface.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_getStationInfo
methods.description: Obtains statistics and info for a specific station device.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_getAllStationsInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info and statistics for all paired station devices.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_copyStationInfoToAssocDev
methods.description: Copies station info into an associated device structure, checking capabilities and radio info.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_sendVendorSubCmd
methods.description: Sends a vendor-specific subcommand to the nl80211 interface.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_sendVendorSubCmdAttr
methods.description: Sends a vendor subcommand with attributes embedded inside vendor data.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_sendManagementFrameCmd
methods.description: Sends a management frame over nl80211.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_registerFrame
methods.description: Registers to receive specific frame types or patterns.

methods.name: wld_ap_nl80211_findMldIfaceInfo
methods.description: Finds MLD interface info including MLO link matching AP MAC address.
